metadata.lyrics:
[Chorus]
당근 당근 아삭아삭
브로콜리 쏙쏙쏙
옥수수 톡톡 톡톡
채소 친구 냠냠냠

[Verse 1]
당근 당근 반가워
길쭉 당근 흔들흔들
브로콜리 반가워
작은 나무 흔들흔들

[Chorus]
당근 당근 아삭아삭
브로콜리 쏙쏙쏙
옥수수 톡톡 톡톡
채소 친구 냠냠냠

[Verse 2]
옥수수야 반가워
노란 알이 톡톡톡
두 손 모아 짝짝짝
모모랑 춤을 춰요

[Final chorus]
당근 당근 아삭아삭
브로콜리 쏙쏙쏙
옥수수 톡톡 톡톡
채소 친구 냠냠냠

[Outro]
당근 브로콜리 옥수수
다 같이 흔들흔들
당근 브로콜리 옥수수
내일 또 만나 안녕
metadata.negative_style: male vocal, deep voice, choir, harsh vocal, spoken narration, rap, trap, heavy drums, long intro, long instrumental solo, excessive melisma, shouting, abrupt cutoff
metadata.style: Original Korean preschool singalong, cheerful acoustic swing shuffle at 118 BPM, major key. One clear light friendly female lead, natural child-friendly diction, small comfortable melodic range. Bouncy upright bass, brushed snare, handclaps, playful clarinet answers and light acoustic guitar. Catchy four-line hook with a rising three-note call and short descending answer, memorable separate phrases, sparse arrangement supporting the voice. Fully sung, not spoken or rap. Around 90 seconds, start singing within 2 seconds, concise sections, repeat supplied chorus, end with complete sung goodbye and 2-second resolved instrumental decay. No source melody or cover.
